stemMarkdown: A boat travels downstream at 20 km/h and upstream at 8 km/h. Find the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water.
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed is boat $+$ stream and upstream is boat $-$ stream. Adding the two cancels the stream: boat speed $= \dfrac{20 + 8}{2} = 14$ km/h.
altSolutionMarkdown: Subtracting instead gives the stream speed: $\dfrac{20 - 8}{2} = 6$ km/h.
